newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt to sell 20 pct of pharmaceutical firm.
newsitem.headline: Egypt to sell 20 pct of pharmaceutical firm.

text.p: The Egyptian state holding company National Pharmaceuticals said on Thursday it was offering 20 percent of its subsidiary Memphis Pharmaceutical and Chemical Industries for sale in a partial privatisation worth 25 million pounds ($7.35 million).
On September 9 and 10, 500,000 of the company's 2.5 million shares will go on sale at 50 pounds each, it said.
The company has allocated 125,000 shares to individuals and 125,000 to mutual funds and investment firms. The allocation to individuals may be increased to meet demand, it said.
It has set aside the other 250,000 shares, 10 percent of the equity, for sale to company employees.
Shareholders will be eligible for a dividend of at least 5.80 pounds a share for the financial year 1995/96, which ended on June 30, it said.
Memphis increased its net profits 10 percent to 19.75 million pounds in 1995/96 from 17.94 million a year ago. Sales rose 8.5 percent to 117.64 million pounds from 108.42 million.
